head: ff28e4ed20a85a9c332f3e9bf499390942bd5f51
claim: A sealed sign-in still reads signed in right after a real Gateway restart on a busy host, and a publication that never lands reads unknown, not signed out

steps.start: A fresh app home holding a synthetic preserved sign-in, on the pinned engine the kit installs from the patched set
steps: The kit imports the preserved sign-in, starts the real pinned engine and confirms the sign-in
The kit stops the engine, which seals the store, and starts it again on a busy host
The app asks which providers are signed in straight after the restart and sees openai
With the post-boot gap held open, the app reads signed in once the engine publishes and unknown if it never does
steps.result: PASS: with the gap held open, the sign-in read signed in once the engine published, and a publication that never landed read unknown, not signed out

verdicts.seen: Read 2 PASS lines. First: '6 copies at once on the real pinned engine 2026.11.1: each sealed sign-in was still signed in right after a real Gateway restart'. Second: 'sign-in read signed in once the engine published, and a publication that never landed read unknown, not signed out'. Both parts of the outcome are shown.

Read the one test line and summary counts. 'a status read while the engine publishes after boot waits for its answer, and one that never comes is unknown' passes; pass 1, fail 0. Also '~/.pi: sign-ins, settings and extensions unchanged'. This supports the unknown-not-signed-out part, not the real restart on a busy host part.
